gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-antic: Distinctive ruler-straight strokes give Happy Monkey its swagger, with wide gaps in the e. And Antic reads like one nib drew every letter, its open mouths easy to travel down line after line.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-ar-one-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Happy Monkey keeps its line weight ruler-straight. AR One Sans comes next with brush ends that lift away before each curve closes, so text moves along with a modern, unhurried feel.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bpmf-huninn: Straight-edged and loud: Happy Monkey holds its line weight ruler-true. It earns its keep in big, short lines, while Bpmf Huninn keeps a single-weight outline feel with a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cairo: Every stroke looks drawn with one fixed pen in Happy Monkey. Cairo sits beside it, opening a wide channel into every bowl and giving text a modern, workmanlike footing.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cambay: Cambay reads modern and open, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Happy Monkey, bent-paperclip simple with no thick-thin shifts, handles the loud moments while Cambay does the quiet, steady talking.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Loud, ruler-straight letters with a wide grin in the e. Chiron Hei HK sits beside it with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, keeping the pairing modern and orderly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-electrolize: Blunt, ruler-straight strokes with wide gaps in the e make Happy Monkey look like it is grinning. Electrolize feels brisk and modern beside it, open-jawed like a pair of pliers.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-fahkwang: Compass-pencil consistency, bold to the bone, with wide gaps in the e: Happy Monkey. Fahkwang, with a faint nib-pressure variation, does the gentle talking and leaves the shouting to its partner.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gayathri: Punchy and pen-steady: Happy Monkey never changes pressure or angle. Gayathri gives open-ended curves a mild letterpress-slug variation that smooths the reading pace, so long paragraphs glide along rather than lurch.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable Gothic A1 sits under Happy Monkey's direction-ignoring, marker-nib swagger. Give Gothic A1 a generous text size and its splayed c terminals will keep a friendly, easy rhythm going down the page.
